_comment: Pictures of the bought components and of every choice in the configurator. 'components' is ordered: a part of a recipe takes the picture of the first component with one of its 'match' patterns in the part's name (lower case). 'kind' is photo (a file under docs/components/ with author, licence and source; the Wikimedia Commons ones are fetched and filled in by scripts/fetch_component_photos.py from the file's own page), drawing (made by python -m microduck.componentpics from the dimensions named in 'origin'; not a photograph) or render (a picture this project already makes: a part thumbnail by 'stl' or 'manifest', a build picture by 'build', a two-wheeled model by 'wheeled_model'). 'options' gives each choice of config/compat.json its component. To use your own photograph see docs/components/README.md. A part whose name starts with one of 'not_bought' is printed and takes no component picture.
